label: PF Backlog 606
title: Grooming/regroom must fully resolve items: populate all fields, interactively surface missing info/deps, never strand IN_PROGRESS
body: Grooming/regroom and groom-all must FULLY resolve every item: populate all fields from AI + deterministic signals, set dependencies and refresh execution order. When required input is missing OR a dependency is unmet, it must SURFACE that to the user for an explicit decision instead of leaving the item NOT_ANALYZED / IN_PROGRESS. No item may be stranded in a silent in-progress state (flagged work piles up and nobody attends to it). Any action that needs input must be requested now; otherwise the item is finalized and downstream stages consume it. Observed on the EDP epic (BI-PF-1292): groom_all left 17/24 children IN_PROGRESS with unanswered missing_info and no prompt.

brief.problem: groom_all strands items IN_PROGRESS with unanswered missing_info and no prompt
brief.what_adds: Completion enforcement + interactive decision surfacing in grooming
brief.why: Flagged work piles up unattended, blocking downstream stages

objective: Grooming/regroom fully resolves every item (fields, deps, exec order); missing input or unmet deps are surfaced for explicit human decision; no item stranded in NOT_ANALYZED/IN_PROGRESS.
acceptance_criteria: After groom-all, zero items remain IN_PROGRESS/NOT_ANALYZED without an attached question or explicit decision request
missing_info or unmet deps always end at /groom/decide or a finalized state
Re-running groom-all finalizes or surfaces every previously stranded item
approach: Add completion-state post-pass and interactive decide handoff inside existing groom pipeline.
verification: Run groom_all on BI-PF-1292 epic; assert 0 stranded
Unit tests for missing_info and unmet-dep paths
risks: Interactive prompts during batch groom-all may not scale for 17+ items
Over-forcing decisions could reduce AI autonomy
rollback: Revert grooming post-pass flag; items return to previous flow.
evidence: BI-PF-1292 epic: 17/24 children IN_PROGRESS after groom_all

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/grooming.py and the groom/groom-all/decide APIs: after AI+signals pass, any unresolved missing_info or unmet deps triggers an interactive decision request (groom/decide) or forces a final status; add a stranded-item guard in groom_all.
